name: an unparseable submission result records nothing and says so
description: Three results that carry no id the harness can stand behind: prose naming a history id and a dataset id that a 16-hex regex fallback would have registered as a job, a success whose data.model_class is Job where an invocation belongs (registering it would send the pollers to /api/invocations/<job id>), and JSON cut off mid-string. Each must log submission.unparsed and leave the notebook alone -- a wrong id binds the record to work nobody did, which is worse than no id.
